learning_outcomes.text: Having sufficient knowledge about hydraulic and pneumatic circuit elements and symbols
The ability to apply the principles of ecomic in the design and operation of pneumatic systems.
Fault detection ability in hydraulic and pneumatic systems.
Ability to read and analyze hydraulic and pneumatic circuits, ability to select control valves according to application types.
Ability to design power units and select transmission lines.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to hydraulics, basic principles of hydraulics
Standard symbols, hydraulic pipe and hoses
Oil reservoir, filters, hydraulic accumulators, hydraulic fluids.
Electro-hydraulic systems, faults in hydraulic systems and their detection.
Hydraulic circuits. Application areas of hydraulics in industry. Hydraulic circuit design and applications.
Hydraulic circuits. Application areas of hydraulics in industry. Hydraulic circuit design and applications.
Introduction to pneumatics. Physical principles in pneumatics.
Production, maintenance and distribution of air.
Standard symbols in pneumatics, cylinders, seals.
Pneumatic motors, valves. Pneumatic circuits and their drawings.
Circuit drawing methods. Application areas of hydro-pneumatic, pneumatic systems.
Fault finding. Electro-pneumatic. System design and installation. Programmable control logic system, its programming and applications.
